```{r gene-filter-ui, results='asis'}
# The gene-list chips. They sit at the top of the Overview (heading in _header.qmd) because
# they drive the key findings directly below as well as both variant tables further down.
# One checkbox per registered panel; no box ticked is the unfiltered state for the tables and
# the "tick a list" state for the key findings; load-time ticks are params$default_panels.
# Ids/classes (.panel-checkbox, #panel-clear, #custom-gene-input, ...) are read by the filter
# hook in per_sample.qmd, facet_filter.js and key_findings.js: do not rename.
all_p = if (!is.null(params$all_panels) && length(params$all_panels) > 0)
          params$all_panels else list()
selected = setdiff(as.character(unlist(params$default_panels)), "__all__")

chip = function(value, label) {
  paste0('  <label class="panel-toggle', if (value %in% selected) " is-on" else "", '">',
         '<input type="checkbox" class="panel-checkbox" value="',
         htmltools::htmlEscape(value, attribute = TRUE), '"',
         if (value %in% selected) " checked" else "", '> ',
         htmltools::htmlEscape(label), '</label>\n')
}

chips = ""
for (nm in names(all_p)) {
  label = paste0(toupper(substr(nm, 1, 1)), substr(nm, 2, nchar(nm)))
  chips = paste0(chips, chip(nm, label))
}
chips = paste0(chips, chip("__custom__", "Custom…"))

cat(paste0('
<div class="panel-controls">
  <span class="panel-controls__label">Gene lists:</span>
  <div class="panel-controls__toggles">
', chips, '  </div>
  <button type="button" id="panel-clear" class="panel-controls__clear">Clear</button>
  <!-- Unhidden by assets/js/facet_filter.js whenever a column tickbox filter is set. It
       sits here rather than by the tables because with scrollY = "400px" a ticked filter
       can be scrolled out of sight, and inside .panel-controls it inherits the print
       hiding for free. It shares .panel-controls__clear with the panel Clear beside it —
       two neutral secondary controls in one bar — so restyling one restyles both. -->
  <button type="button" id="facet-clear" class="panel-controls__clear" hidden>Clear value filters</button>
  <span id="panel-variant-count" class="panel-controls__count"></span>
</div>
<div id="custom-gene-panel" class="panel-controls__custom-area" style="display:none;">
  <label>Custom genes — one per line, or comma/space separated, case-insensitive:</label>
  <textarea id="custom-gene-input" rows="4"></textarea>
</div>
'))
```

```{r gene-filter-note}
# Wrapped so print can drop it: report.scss prints every table_details() expanded, and this
# one would push the key findings off the first page
tags$div(class = "gene-filter-note", table_details(
  summary = "What the gene lists apply to",
  "The ticked lists choose the key findings below and filter the small-variant and",
  "structural-variant tables further down. Tick any number: a finding, variant or SV is kept",
  "if it hits", tags$strong("any"), "of them. With none ticked the tables are unfiltered and",
  "the key findings ask for a list. Small variants match on gene symbol; SVs match on",
  "breakend position when the list carries coordinates — see the note under the SV table",
  "for which mode each ticked list is in.",
  tags$br(),
  "With more than one list ticked, each panel_hit entry names the list it matched in",
  "square brackets.",
  tags$br(),
  "A list may also scope individual genes to one table — a rearrangement partner such as",
  tags$code("IGH"), "is worth filtering SVs on but not small variants, and a coding-mutation",
  "gene the other way round. The note under the SV table names the split for each ticked list.",
  tags$br(),
  "A custom list is bare symbols, which carry no coordinates, so its SVs are matched on",
  "the annotated breakend genes only — no positional window."
))
```
